name: Jamshri Realty Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1907, Jamshri Realty Ltd (formerly known as Jamshri Ranjit Singhji Spinning and Weaving Mills Co Ltd) is engaged in real estate development, leasing of its space and Hospitality business[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company established JR Ignite Business IT Park, expanding across 2 Lac sq. ft. in Solapur. Company lets out its space for commercial purposes where companies can begin their operations at a competitive cost

pros: Debtor days have improved from 34.8 to 27.0 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.50%
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.32 Cr.
